justification: The cone flaw is genuine and distinct from the hyperbolic-decomposition flaw. Using the [paper’s cone construction](https://arxiv.org/html/2306.14317v2#S2.SS1), take q=2, R=F₅, V=F₂⁵, and L=span(b₁). For every line U, ∂c_U=U−L. Since a plane W has three lines, ∂(W−c_{∂W})=3L≠0. Thus the proposed generators need not be cycles.
